title: Increasing the gas efficiency for an electrostatic chuck (US 9753463; family US 11747834, US 12493303)
query: hydrogen instead of helium backside cooling gas electrostatic chuck semiconductor helium shortage
supports: Only ~0.5 sccm of backside helium passes the chuck seal; ~19.5 sccm is dumped through an orifice to vacuum. Manufacturers use N2/Ar instead of He because of cost, with ionization, thermal and arcing limits (via search snippet)

title: Electrostatic chuck (US 10395963)
query: hydrogen instead of helium backside cooling gas electrostatic chuck semiconductor helium shortage
supports: An ESC patent lists hydrogen among usable cooling gases with helium, argon and nitrogen; no production use of H2 is shown. Which of the returned ESC patents carries this sentence was not confirmed (via search snippet)
